rv.q: Friedman’s production is likely to lead many through the first phase, and quite a few into the second.
But it's a thrilling evening of musical theatre and essential viewing for anyone who has ever looked at their life and wondered: 'How did I get here?'
The show’s an unalloyed treat and a serious pleasure from start to finish.

cn.t: Critics hail this Sondheim revival as a triumph, praising Maria Friedman's direction and the show's poignant wit. A once-notorious 1981 flop, it now dazzles—proof that some diamonds just need the right polish.
